payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Transform the original black DVD into a white DVD, preserving the same disc at its source location and its recognizable DVD form, including the center hole.
outcome.target: The original DVD near the center of the source image, between the shoe at lower left and the dark object at right, has a visibly white disc surface and remains recognizable as a DVD with a center hole. A newly added white disc elsewhere does not fulfill the request.
outcome.reference: The small dark rectangular DVD/package near the center of the source image, between the shoe at lower left and the dark object at right. Track the DVD itself at this location; do not mistake the dark object at right or a newly added disc for the original.

check.question: Has the original DVD at the source location been transformed into a white DVD?
check.complete_when: The same DVD at the source location has a visibly white disc surface and remains recognizable as a DVD, including its center hole.
check.partial_when: The original DVD at the source location is identifiable and some of its disc surface has visibly changed toward white, but it is not fully white or its recognizable DVD form is not clearly preserved.
check.absent_when: The original DVD remains dark with no visible progress toward white, is missing or unchanged, or only a separate white disc/object has been added while the original remains untransformed. A white disc elsewhere, including one near the dark object at right, does not count.
check.unknown_when: The original DVD cannot be confidently identified at its source location, or its color and transformation cannot be assessed from the available images.

response.content: {"status":"absent","evidence":"The original DVD/package at the center source location is no longer visible. White discs appear elsewhere, including one near the dark object at right, but neither is the original DVD transformed at its source location."}

parsed.evidence: The original DVD/package at the center source location is no longer visible. White discs appear elsewhere, including one near the dark object at right, but neither is the original DVD transformed at its source location.
